scope: The original inventory and productionTree are retained. The host startup replays exercise seven additional complete function bodies. The strict stock-emulator results below cover a subset of target instruction and peripheral-model paths. Hardware measurements and independent visual approval remain open.

routes.notConstructed: Physical power-on and SPL handoff, IRQ/audio/USB electrical behavior, LCD color and flash power-loss persistence on a board.
routes.displayEvidence: The complete fm1_cstart runs over private linker regions. The seven-case compiled replay follows fm1_main from accepted JEDEC through startup, the first ordinary frame or the update endpoint. It checks foreign and matching owners, stale OTA, stored and default splashes, the full countdown, a recovered valid shadow, and the already-live control. Both sample cases publish the restored loop after project load and have identical 240×240 ordinary frames. See native-routes/normal-loop/normal-loop.json. The linked target-instruction replay is separately scoped in native-routes/stock-boot.json. The linked stock Elite and Pro packages also run from the application entry to the splash and ordinary screen in strict emu360. Fresh-process restarts read the recovered sample without a flash write. Final Synth One builds repeated the complete suite in native-routes/stock-final.json.

routes.notConstructed: Electrical fault origin, physical clock accuracy and reboot on a board.
routes.displayEvidence: The complete fault function draws its diagnostics, polls its timer and requests a host reset. Its framebuffer matches the archived diagnostic. Both final linked packages take the modeled CPU exception vector twice, record the actual fault PC and diagnostic registers, paint the matching LCD and request timed chip resets. See native-routes/stock-guard.json.

routes.notConstructed: Physical watchdog, key contacts, USB electrical behavior and power/reset circuitry.
routes.displayEvidence: The full safe_main function handles held PLAY across its time guard and a modeled USB bootloader request. Both core cases, prompted retry and the resulting endpoints are checked. After the second modeled guard exception both final packages enter safe mode. Their PLAY contacts within the matrix scanner produce the retry frame and PR_PWR reset, then the post-crash notice. All five per-model recorded recovery states match their crash-register-specific 240×240 oracle. See native-routes/stock-guard.json.

failedUpdateReturn.route: During recovery, a host requests an update but sends no package. Three 5-second attempts expire. The updater shows FAILED for 1.5 seconds and returns to safe_main. The original loop retained that frame while awaiting PLAY.
failedUpdateReturn.change: Redraw the safe-mode controls and retained crash registers after the updater returns. Reuse the initial safe-mode painter without restarting the input scanner, USB or the bootguard timer.
failedUpdateReturn.oracle: Compare complete 240×240 RGB frames to the archived PACKAGE, FAILED, core-2 safe-mode and retry frames, and remove the recovery redraw as a negative control.
failedUpdateReturn.boundaries: The regression fixture uses a simulated clock, unanswered USB requests, modeled staging cleanup and the host RGB565 LCD. Historical linked-image runs did not exercise this sequence.

routes.notConstructed: Physical USB detach and actual bootloader transition.
routes.displayEvidence: The complete function executes both direct and USB-request paths, checks detach/delays, clears pending in RAM and reaches the modeled bootloader endpoint. Both stock SMK firmwares also reach their matching updater frames, emulated USB detach on the USB route, and a PR_PWR reset with no flash operations. See native-routes/stock-panel.json. The final firmware rerun is in native-routes/stock-final.json.

routes.notConstructed: Electrical matrix/encoder acquisition, physical elapsed time and persistent device storage.
routes.displayEvidence: The complete calibration function consumes simulated button edges and encoder turns. All 21 prompts, three timeout/rollback paths, successful RAM persistence and the final clear are checked. Both stock packages use the timed matrix/encoder scanner to teach a rotated 14-button mapping and seven encoders with alternating directions. All 21 prompt frames and the title match the archived pixels. The saved 32-byte mapping reloads after a fresh emulator boot. See native-routes/stock-panel.json. Final firmware results are in native-routes/stock-final.json.

routes.notConstructed: Native LCD power/reset and hardware bus initialization.
routes.displayEvidence: The production lcd_init, lcd_window, lcd_data, lcd_fill and lcd_blit run against a RAM SPI endpoint. Both linked stock SMK packages also execute the timed SPI/LCD path in strict emu360. Recovery and already-live splashes at 448 ms and ordinary screens at 1,500 ms match all 57,600 native host RGB565 pixels. See native-routes/stock-boot.json.

routes.notConstructed: The final source has no caller of strip_value_fit. Its only call to drum_strip_glyph supplies DG_LEVEL, outside the DG_DECAY/DG_NTAIL branches that invoke dg_tail.
routes.displayEvidence: The earlier dispatch analysis is recorded in stockSourceAudit. See finalStockSource for the revised source and both linked ELF symbols.

routes.notConstructed: No admitted combination of Chicago or Miami waveform edits and previews selects this fallback on the current oscillator pages. This conclusion follows from the finite native-field domain. Physical-device observation remains open.
routes.displayEvidence: A malformed sibling cutoff lock exercises the real projector rejection and fallback on a full Chicago oscillator page. Painter elision localizes 43 pixels. See native-routes/wave-frame.json. The simultaneous-preview source audit and its assumptions are in native-routes/README.md#simultaneous-wave-previews.

routes.notConstructed: The generic bank footer has no physical dispatch with these parameters on the admitted bass pages.
routes.displayEvidence: describe_pages emits sound/bank controls under V_PART. draw_knobs returns after draw_part_sound for that view; the V_SEQ preset uses R_BPATSND. See native-routes/README.md.

otherHelpers: The stock source review in renderer-gaps.json traces nine helpers with no reachable caller and three page/parameter combinations excluded by dispatch. These dispositions add no observed functions.

sourceCoverage.scope: Original 1,712-frame run; supplemental execution is listed separately.

stockSourceAudit.laneLocalName: The lane painter has one occurrence followed by a call parenthesis, its definition. The prior source review distinguishes same-name locals and fields.

dispatchExcluded.strip_value_fit: Its only call requires a drum reference in draw_param_widget. That widget is called only from draw_part_sound on bass pages. Both the main-band and knob-strip drum selection dispatch to draw_drum_voice.
dispatchExcluded.dg_tail: Its callers require DG_DECAY or DG_NTAIL in drum_strip_glyph. Outside the bass matrix widget, the only call to drum_strip_glyph requires DG_LEVEL. drum_strip_role rejects a bass reference.
dispatchExcluded.original_cell_value: describe_pages only emits R_ENG/T_303 and the three R_BENGINE/R_BPRESET/R_BSTATUS controls under V_PART for bass. draw_knobs returns at ui.c:8495 for that part and view. V_SEQ uses R_BPATSND, which does not satisfy the call predicate.

stockSourceAudit.scope: All 20 original IDs have dispositions. The source exclusions add zero executed frame or hardware observations. Counts apply to 11bc3f3a. The source scan used exact identifiers and masked comments and literals.

updates.strip_value_fit: The sole identifier occurrence in ui.c is the static definition. The bass matrix no longer contains its former conditional drum caller.
updates.dg_tail: The sole production call to drum_strip_glyph supplies the constant DG_LEVEL. Its DG_DECAY and DG_NTAIL cases cannot reach the tail from stock dispatch.

finalStockSource.scope: The 11bc3f3a stockSourceAudit and original 98/118 frame inventory above are historical. These final dispositions add no executed frames.
